title: herdr's collect has no report-only check; a herdr worker that commits only its report collects as ready-to-merge
body: internal/exec/herdr/collect.go refuses only commits===0; an agent that commits its own report and nothing else leaves one commit and reads ready-to-merge — the same lie dyo refused on the cloud executor and 94u refused on the door's TS collect. The shape differs per substrate (herdr's entrypoint does not commit the report, the agent does), so whether it is a defect or the honest 'evidence-only verification worker' of the learnings is a decision, but it is currently no one's recorded decision.
